units: <cite ref="Gittin 57b:5">Gitt. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>שדא פירטא בביתיה וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>שדר שטר פרטתא</he>, Rashi <cite ref="Q01961"><he>פיר׳</he></cite>) he sent a document containing the inventory and disposal of his property to his house, and became a proselyte; v. <cite ref="Q00635"><he>פִּיטְרָא</he> II</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 96b:7">Snh. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>שדר פּוּרְטִיתָא לביתיה</he>.
